_: Clean-room policy consumed by cleanroom_hook.py and session_audit.py. Copy to <project>/.gemini/cleanroom-policy.json (Gemini CLI) or <workspace>/.agents/cleanroom-policy.json (Antigravity) and edit; the hook checks .gemini, .agents, .agent then .claude, or $CLEANROOM_POLICY if you'd rather name it outright. Keep the patterns in sync with assets/gemini-policy.toml, which denies the same targets at the policy-engine layer. checkout_roots MUST list every local encumbered checkout (better: don't mount them in implementation workspaces at all). Matching is case-insensitive substring, not glob. Denylists are leaky by nature - the environment tier (no checkout, egress allowlist) is the real guarantee.
